name: Fusou Ryousuke
source:
When he was a child, he left the mansion with his mother, who was disgusted by his father's womanizing. However, he was forced to return to the house by his father's will.

After his mother's death, he was placed in an institution, but he escaped from there. As he continues to live in squalor, his ungovernable anger is directed toward the women who caused him to leave the mansion.

[Translated from the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080224074935/http://www.gesakuza.co.jp/pc/index.htm]official website[/url]]
